init_KmeansAssigner: create a KmeansAssigner instance by loading centroids from a file path with optional normalization
feat2cluster_assign: compute cluster assignments for feature tensors by finding nearest centroids using cosine distance
cluster2feat_lookup: retrieve feature vectors for given cluster indices by looking up centroids
forward_KmeansAssigner: run the KmeansAssigner forward pass to map features to clusters or clusters to features
num_clusters_property: get the number of clusters from a KmeansAssigner instance via the num_clusters property
